package.name: racer_bringup
package.description: Launch files, per-machine configs (claude-docs/02-repo-layout.md; claude-docs/10- conventions.md: "Launch files in racer_bringup only"). Milestone 1 adds sim_teleop.launch.py: bridge_node + safety_node (the real /drive_raw -> safety_node -> /drive -> bridge_node command path), plus bridge.launch.py (moved from sim/bridge/racer_gym_bridge). Milestone 2 adds the `viz` argument to sim_teleop.launch.py, starting foxglove_bridge for a live Foxglove view; see config/foxglove_sim_viz.layout.json and docs/notes/milestone-2-sim-viz.md. Milestone 3 adds sim_autopilot.launch.py: bridge_node + safety_node + tracker_node (+ raceline_publisher_node + foxglove_bridge) -- the classical stack drives the sim car itself; see config/foxglove_sim_autopilot.layout.json and docs/notes/milestone-3-sim-autopilot.md.
